images.alt: Collage of photos showing members of NZMAT (New Zealand Medical Assistance Team) during training day. Images include a large beige field tent being set up indoors, a group photo outdoors with team members holding a New Zealand Medical Assistance Team banner, a close up of a uniform with ‘New Zealand Health’ on the back, and several group shots of the full team wearing matching uniforms. The bottom-right image shows the team standing in front of the assembled emergency tent.

post.text:
NZMAT recently delivered training for a new cohort of team members, joined by health professionals, FENZ members, and colleagues from Pacific Island countries.
Huge thanks to everyone who contributed and to MFAT for supporting this critical capability.

#NZMAT #EMTeams #FEMAT #SEMAT #KukiMAT
